2050001.name: Idol and Detective
2050001.profiles: A master detective and idol assistant arrive in one mysterious city. With one urgent case to investigate, time is of the essence.

2050002.name: Fragmented Emotions
2050002.profiles: Flames lurk within the crowd – rather, every member of the crowd IS a flame. Intriguing...

2050003.name: Richard's Plan
2050003.profiles: Faced with a standstill, Richard hatches a plan. The ultimate plan, which will allow everyone to have fun...

2050004.name: Face-Off
2050004.profiles: "You're saying it's time to put an end to this. A nice little duel to the death?"

2050005.name: Light Versus Dark
2050005.profiles: Astrarium is split between light and dark. The battle rages on endlessly...

2050006.name: Rain Upon Flowery Seas
2050006.profiles: In the depths of the thunderstorm, a courtyard seems to appear. Lightning pierces the darkness, creating a rift where flowers bloom.

2050041.name: Depths of the Astrarium
2050041.profiles: "A thousand words, a thousand faces. A deceptive visage, a bewitched heart. O travelers, gather here. O dreams, ascend here. To all those who've wandered astray, we welcome you to Astrarium."
